content.comment_body: I need to save data to a file every 5 seconds, which results in about 17,280 rows per day. Will [product_name] automatically generate a new file each day? It seems impractical to store all days within a single file.

A data log file stored on the SD card is limited to 20,000 lines. Once the file reaches this limit, [product_name] creates a new data log file automatically. Each SD card can hold up to 50 data log files in total.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about how the data-logging feature in [product_name] handles file creation and management, particularly with respect to file size limits and the ability to organize logs over multiple days. Uncertainty around whether daily log separation happens automatically impacts long-term usability and data management for continuous logging scenarios.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking features such as automatic file generation for each day or straightforward long-term log management, which could prevent oversized files and simplify daily data retrieval.
